title: customer_segmentation
summary: An end-to-end MLOps customer segmentation project deployed on Databricks via asset bundles. Its data-creation module uses SDV's SingleTableMetadata and TVAESynthesizer to detect metadata from a dataframe and generate synthetic customer data for testing and model development.
evidence: src/data/create_data.py:4-24 imports SingleTableMetadata and TVAESynthesizer, calls detect_from_dataframe and TVAESynthesizer(self.metadata)
